data.message-story-yu-001-002|details[12].tex: Hehe, then {user} is more Kyoto-style, huh.
data.message-story-yu-001-002|details[13].tex: Kyoto and Osaka actually have pretty different cultures, you know. I say that in interviews and meetings, of course, softly, so as not to offend anyone.
data.message-story-yu-001-002|details[14].tex: But people just don't get it.
data.message-story-yu-001-002|details[19].tex: People don't understand my feelings or Kansai enough.
data.message-story-yu-001-002|details[1].text: I wonder if there's a job where I can appeal more~?
data.message-story-yu-001-002|details[20].tex: I need to make them understand the difference properly!
data.message-story-yu-001-002|details[2].text: Hmm, like a tourism ambassador, for instance.

data.message-story-yu-001-002|details[6].text: You're quick on the uptake—that's a lifesaver!

data.message-story-yu-001-003|details[16].tex: You sharp-eyed manager! That chain I like, and that place with the great gyoza, both originated in Kyoto, you know.
data.message-story-yu-001-003|details[17].tex: But I wonder if today's young people don't really eat them anymore?
data.message-story-yu-001-003|details[18].tex: The aroma of that rich broth just pierces right through from your nose to the top of your head.
data.message-story-yu-001-003|details[1].choi: Try not to say anything weird.

data.message-story-yu-001-003|details[3].text: Of course lololol I'm gunning for tourism ambassador, after all.
data.message-story-yu-001-003|details[4].text: I won't do anything to sully my white wings.
data.message-story-yu-001-003|details[6].text: It's still a ways from tourism ambassador, but
data.message-story-yu-001-003|details[9].text: You're joking, right. I'm suddenly all fired up~!
data.message-story-yu-001-004|details[0].text: The show about regional character was a huge success~!
data.message-story-yu-001-004|details[2].text: But I'll keep waiting until you're on board, {user} www

data.message-story-yu-001-004|details[4].text: {user}, you kept me company through all my rambling beforehand, so I've really got to thank you~

data.message-story-yu-001-004|details[6].text: You could become a Kyoto expert.
data.message-story-yu-001-004|details[7].text: But you know, there's still plenty I haven't taught you.

data.message-story-yu-001-004|details[9].text: Let's go on a trip to Kyoto together someday.
